# Metcalf Search
> Fractional recruiting for small and mid-sized businesses, built around the STACK Method (Source, Tempo, Assess, Close, Keep). Flat monthly subscription, no per-hire fees, a single point of contact on the team. Based in Columbus, Ohio, working with businesses locally and beyond.
Metcalf Search is a fractional recruiting firm run by Jay Metcalf (27 years in recruiting, more than $100 million in salary placed). It helps small and growing businesses with hiring, including skilled trades, manufacturing, distribution, and professional services. It sits between contingency agencies and full-time internal recruiters as a third option: an embedded recruiting function on a flat monthly subscription. Three tiers: Recruiting Partner ($2,950 a month, one active role at a time), Recruiting Partner Plus ($5,950 a month, two to three concurrent roles and up to 8 hours onsite a month), Recruiting Partner Pro ($10,950 a month, full embedded recruiting across the company). Month to month, no per-hire fees. The free hiring guides cover finding candidates, candidate communication, interviewing, job offers, and employee retention. These topics are organized under the STACK Method labels Source, Tempo, Assess, Close, and Keep. Keep means keeping people productive, satisfied, and engaged, for new hires and existing employees. It asks whether the work is going well and whether this is still a job the person wants to keep. The three moves are Stay connected, Make work better, and Follow through. Record manager and employee commitments, name an owner and review date for each action, and check whether the underlying issue is resolved. Completing an action does not by itself resolve an issue.

- [Activate](https://metcalfsearch.com/activate): The three tiers side by side, each linking to its own page and checkout
- [Recruiting Partner](https://metcalfsearch.com/recruiting-partner): $2,950 a month. One active role at a time, for a company with one seat open and a few more coming this year
- [Recruiting Partner Plus](https://metcalfsearch.com/recruiting-partner-plus): $5,950 a month. Two to three roles at once and a weekly hiring huddle and up to 8 hours onsite a month, for hiring that does not stop
- [Recruiting Partner Pro](https://metcalfsearch.com/recruiting-partner-pro): $10,950 a month. A dedicated recruiter onsite three days a week on every open role in the agreed scope, for companies hiring constantly
- [Comparison chart](https://metcalfsearch.com/comparison): Fractional recruiter vs contingency agency vs staffing vs in-house vs RPO, side by side

## Free hiring guides
- [Small business hiring guides](https://metcalfsearch.com/stack-method): Practical help organized by the hiring problem a business needs to solve
- [Finding qualified candidates](https://metcalfsearch.com/source): How small businesses compete for talent
- [Candidate communication and hiring timelines](https://metcalfsearch.com/tempo): Process rhythm, ghosting, response time
- [Interviewing and evaluating candidates](https://metcalfsearch.com/assess): Structured interviews, scorecards, skill assessment
- [Job offers and counteroffers](https://metcalfsearch.com/close): Counter-offers, offer acceptance, late-stage drops
- [Employee retention and check-ins](https://metcalfsearch.com/keep): Ongoing check-ins, recognition, growth, and follow-through for new hires and existing employees, with ninety-day and annual milestones
- [Employee check-in guide and worksheet](https://metcalfsearch.com/keep-check-in): A regular conversation about work, recognition, support, and follow-through, with a standalone printable worksheet
- [Employee concern guide and worksheet](https://metcalfsearch.com/keep-concern): Hear both perspectives, check facts and support, agree on changes, and review their effect, with a standalone printable worksheet
